Serving via `next start` (pid 5829, next-server v16.2.6) removes the dev HMR client; no /_next/webpack-hmr WebSocket attempts remain and hydration completes. rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_1 root cause confirmed and resolved: the preview ingress does not proxy the Next dev HMR WebSocket (wss://.../_next/webpack-hmr -> 502/404), which stalled client hydration. Serving a production build eliminates the dev client runtime entirely; hydration probe Object.keys(el).some(k=>k.startsWith('__react')) now returns true on the public URL and all rail interactions respond. The keyboard defect was fixed by relocating the keydown listener from .work-rail__viewport (a sibling subtree of the nav buttons) to the outer .work-rail container so button-focused arrow keys bubble to it.
